name: Connect Deriv and show the dashboard without a duplicate connection panel
covers: market and strategy panels remain visible
latest quote and last digit update in place without retaining previous tick rows
description: Verifies OAuth retrieves Options accounts and the dashboard uses the selected account's one-time OTP URL for authenticated market data while keeping the connected layout clean.
expected: The connected dashboard shows Market settings and Strategy control, does not show a Connect Deriv panel, has a Disconnect button, and displays only the latest quote and digit without a Recent Ticks list.

name: Remove numbering from the dashboard
description: Verifies dashboard sections use plain labels without step numbering or numeric badges.
steps: Inspect the Market settings and Strategy control headings
expected: No STEP labels or numeric step badges are displayed.

name: Disconnect returns to the connection screen
description: Verifies disconnect ends the local Deriv session and returns the user to the connection screen.
expected: The connected dashboard disappears and the Connect Deriv screen is shown.

name: Trading remains disabled while market data is read-only
description: Verifies the dashboard does not enable trading simply because the account is connected.
expected: The Run strategy button remains disabled and the market feed is described as read-only.
